description: This PHP file defines a 'Loader' class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform, responsible for dynamically loading models, controllers, views, language files, libraries, and helpers, as well as managing related interactions, method calls, and event triggers.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A class providing methods to load and manage MVC components, libraries, views, language files, and helpers in the OpenCart system, facilitating dynamic resource management and event-driven interactions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Loader with a Registry instance.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Provides access to registry entries via property overloading.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Sets registry entries via property overloading.

methods.name: controller
methods.description: Loads and executes a specified controller method, handling route sanitization, event triggers, and error management.

methods.name: model
methods.description: Loads and registers a model class, creating a proxy for its methods, with error handling for failed loads.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Renders a view template with provided data, handling pre- and post-rendering events.

methods.name: language
methods.description: Loads language files and triggers associated events.

methods.name: library
methods.description: Loads a library class and stores it in the registry.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Loads configuration settings with associated event triggers.

methods.name: helper
methods.description: Includes helper PHP files, based on route, handling extension-based paths.

methods.name: callback
methods.description: Creates a callable wrapper for model methods, managing loading, event triggers, and error handling.
